newsitem.title: USA: GM Delphi venture expands into India. [CORRECTED 16:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: GM Delphi venture expands into India. [CORRECTED 16:35 GMT]

text.p: General Motors Corp.'s Delphi Interior & Lighting Systems unit said Thursday it recently approved the expansion of its Sung San Co Ltd lighting joint venture into India.
Sung San, located in Taegu, South Korea, is a joint venture between Delphi Interior & Lighting and Sam Lip Industrial Co and designs and manufactures automotive lighting products.
Sung San will be part of a new joint venture in Noida, India, with Fiem Industries (corrects from Diem Industries) and DCM Daewoo Motors Ltd.
The India venture, called Fiem Sung San (India) Ltd, will initially supply lighting products for DCM Daewoo Motors in Surajpur for the Cielo and J-100 programs.
Sung San will build tools and test equipment in addition to providing technical assistance for the joint venture.

Based in Warren, Mich., Delphi Interior & Lighting Systems, a division of GM's Delphi Automotive Systems components unit, is a worldwide supplier of lighting and seating systems, cockpit and door modules, air bag systems and steering wheels.
